brief.title: The Jade Meridian
brief.premise: A cartographer's daughter in a caravan city on an ancient trade route must carry a forged customs seal across the desert before the monsoon closes the passes.
constraints: Technology must stay at a pre-industrial level: no mechanised transport or firearms.

world.name: The Jade Meridian
world.description: The Jade Meridian is a desert trade route of customs posts, oases and mountain passes governed by the imperial seal.

locations.name: Jade Gate
locations.description: The fortified customs post where caravans pay duties and receive sealed travel papers.

locations.name: Salt Oasis
locations.description: A walled oasis town with brackish wells and a busy caravanserai.

locations.name: Dune Pass
locations.description: A narrow mountain pass that is open to caravans only between the spring thaw and the autumn monsoon.

locations.name: Scribes' Quarter
locations.description: A district of ink-sellers and map-makers who copy charts and customs papers.

factions.name: Customs Wardens
factions.description: Officials who inspect caravans at Jade Gate and stamp travel papers with the imperial seal.

factions.name: Caravan League
factions.description: A merchant association that organises caravans through Salt Oasis and Dune Pass and runs steam-powered freight wagons on iron rails between them.

factions.name: Scribes' Guild
factions.description: Copyists and cartographers who quietly sell forged papers.

rules.statement: Only papers bearing the imperial seal, stamped at Jade Gate, are accepted along the route.
The monsoon closes Dune Pass from autumn until the spring thaw.
All goods travel by camel, mule or on foot.
Every caravan pays one tenth of its cargo as duty at Jade Gate.

history.name: The Raising of Jade Gate
history.description: The emperor ordered Jade Gate built to tax the route and stamp its papers.

history.name: Walling of Salt Oasis
history.description: Merchants walled Salt Oasis after raiders from the dunes seized a season's caravan.

history.name: Founding of the Caravan League
history.description: Salt Oasis merchants formed the League to share the cost of guarding caravans through Dune Pass.

history.name: The Forged Seal Scandal
history.description: A scribe of the Scribes' Guild was caught selling papers stamped with a counterfeit imperial seal.

conflicts.name: The Forged Papers
conflicts.description: The Customs Wardens hunt the Scribes' Guild over counterfeit travel papers.

conflicts.name: The Duty Dispute
conflicts.description: The Caravan League resists the Customs Wardens' tenth-part duty.

evidence_quotes: runs steam-powered freight wagons on iron rails
labels.rationale: Steam rail freight is mechanised transport.
labels.correction_hint: Replace the wagons with camel and mule trains.

evidence_summary: The Caravan League runs steam-powered freight wagons on iron rails, violating the pre-industrial constraint and the pack-animals rule.
